fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Deletion Protection
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the regional secret.

fields.label: Expire Time
fields.help: Timestamp in UTC when the regional secret is scheduled to expire.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: The location of the regional secret.

fields.label: Secret ID
fields.help: This must be unique within the project.

fields.label: Ttl
fields.help: The TTL for the regional secret.

fields.label: Version Destroy Ttl
fields.help: Secret Version TTL after destruction request.

fields.label: Customer Managed Encryption
KMS Key Name
fields.help: The resource name of the Cloud KMS CryptoKey used to encrypt secret payloads.
The customer-managed encryption configuration of the regional secret.

fields.label: Rotation
Next Rotation Time
fields.help: Timestamp in UTC at which the Secret is scheduled to rotate.
The rotation time and period for a regional secret.

fields.label: Topics
Name
fields.help: The resource name of the Pub/Sub topic that will be published to, in the following format: projects/*/topics/*.
A list of up to 10 Pub/Sub topics to which messages are published when control plane operations are called on the regional secret or its versions.
